tips.label: Before you buy a cordless tool:
tips.text: check on the product page whether a battery and charger are included. Many cordless tools are sold as the tool only, which suits someone who already owns batteries of the same brand.

tips.label: Compare retailers:
tips.text: every Construction Gear World product page shows the price at each retailer that sells the tool. Check the delivery time on the retailer's website before you buy: some tools are sent to order, which can take a few extra days.
